blocks.text: DETROIT — Isaiah Joe scored 22 points to help the Detroit Pistons overcome a slow start and beat the Milwaukee Bucks 113-98 in an NBA Cup game Friday night. The Pistons won East Group A at 3-1 with a better points differential than the Toronto Raptors and Orlando Magic. Detroit will host a knockout-round game and could finish with the Eastern Conference’s top seed. The Bucks finished 0-4 in group play.
